shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖立管、抽出的绒毛刷杆与身后一片抹开的雾面泥色块同时交代器形与哑光质地

shots.intent: 把上唇动作与五格唇部微距并排，让买家在同一套妆效语言里自行比对该系列的可选色域

shots.intent: 用仰角晴空与风中发丝把产品放进户外持妆的想象里，右下角器形与色块完成品牌位留白

style.backgroundSystem: seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF for packshots and swatch charts, one large arch-shaped aperture with a fixed corner radius opening onto a pale sky-slate field #BFD0DC for the two daylight scenes, and matte shell-cream limestone blocks #EFE6DC for the group screen; coral #E0614C is reserved for small graphic accents, frame rules and label outlines and never carries a lip or swatch hue, because every shade value is carried by the accent placeholder
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline rules, small four-point star marks and blank rounded label pills outlined in coral #E0614C, hairline leader lines running from each swatch block to one unprinted label slot, no filled illustrative icons and no tick, cross or arrow graphics
style.lightingSystem: hard directional afternoon sun from the upper left with crisp dappled shadow shapes falling across skin in the daylight scenes, bright even high-key studio key from a front-left softbox with a fill card on the packshot and group screens, skimming sweep across matte swatch ridges, soft contact shadows only, never a wet specular on a velvet finish
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sunlit editorial lip colour visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF, pale sky-slate daylight field #BFD0DC, shell-cream limestone #EFE6DC and one coral graphic accent #E0614C, with every lip and swatch hue carried by one accent placeholder; hard directional afternoon sun from the upper left with crisp dappled shadow shapes on skin, bright even high-key studio light with a front-left softbox key and fill card on product screens, skimming sweep across matte swatch ridges, soft contact shadows and no wet speculars; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight hairline rules, small four-point star marks, hairline leader lines and blank rounded label pills; one large arch-shaped aperture with a fixed corner radius recurring across the set; stable open-tube-with-applicator anchor angle and scale with powdery feathered swipe edges; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no fixed lip shade hue across the set
no glossy finish on a matte product
style.presentationRules: one open-tube-with-flocked-applicator anchor reused at stable scale, formula always rendered as powdery velvet with feathered swipe edges, the arch aperture and its corner radius kept identical wherever it appears, human crops kept generic and unidentifiable, and every lip or swatch hue carried by the accent placeholder instead of a fixed shade
style.surfaceSystem: seamless porcelain white sweep #FFFFFF laid without a visible horizon or table edge, plus matte shell-cream limestone blocks #EFE6DC stacked at three different heights as plinths, one rounded porcelain information card #FFFFFF for the spec zone
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only: one oversized display line, one light subline and small label rows, all in-image copy supplied at generation time as placeholders
